scripts.dev: tsc -b && concurrently --kill-others --names packages,server,client "tsc -b --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --import tsx apps/server/server.ts" "npm run dev --workspace @moke/client -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -b apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @moke/client
scripts.desktop: npm run build:native --workspace @moke/shell && tsc -b && concurrently --kill-others --names packages,server,client "tsc -b --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --import tsx apps/server/server.ts" "npm run desktop --workspace @moke/client"
